name: Start Campus SIN02 — public-information underwriting demo

metadata.warning: This is not a credit opinion on Start Campus. Public facts are combined with clearly labelled synthetic uncertainty assumptions solely to exercise the ProofMW engine.

evidence.title: Start Campus — Building Europe's AI Future from the Atlantic Coast
evidence.excerpt: The SIN02 200MW Data Centre – Coming online by H2 2027.
evidence.claim: SIN02 is publicly described as a 200 MW data centre targeted to come online in H2 2027.

evidence.title: Start Campus — Sines Data Campus
evidence.excerpt: 1.2GW total campus capacity; 200 MW next planned facility.
evidence.claim: Start Campus publicly states 1.2 GW total campus capacity and identifies SIN02 as the next 200 MW facility.

evidence.title: Open Compute Project — Start Campus SIN02
evidence.excerpt: SIN02 is described as ready-to-build/de-risked, high-density AI/Cloud/HPC capable, with ocean-water cooling and renewable power access.
evidence.claim: OCP lists SIN02 and records public design/site-readiness claims relevant to physical bankability.

evidence.title: Start Campus — power allocation announcement
evidence.excerpt: Additional power secured ... total IT capacity secured for SINES DC to 1.2 GW.
evidence.claim: The developer publicly states that grid power for the 1.2 GW campus has been secured.

evidence.title: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente — RECAPE Data Center Sines 4.0 notice
evidence.excerpt: RECAPE do Projeto de Execução Data Center Sines 4.0
evidence.claim: Portuguese environmental authority records show a RECAPE process for Data Center Sines 4.0.

evidence.title: Synthetic uncertainty assumption — grid energisation
evidence.excerpt: Delay and derating distributions are hypothetical because the underlying interconnection agreement and energisation schedule are not public in this demo.
evidence.claim: Use a bounded triangular schedule-risk distribution for grid energisation until private evidence is supplied.

evidence.title: Synthetic uncertainty assumption — construction
evidence.excerpt: Construction schedule distribution is hypothetical and intentionally conservative for product testing.
evidence.claim: Use a bounded triangular construction-delay distribution pending EPC schedule evidence.

evidence.title: Synthetic uncertainty assumption — cooling commissioning
evidence.excerpt: Cooling commissioning distribution is hypothetical pending detailed design and commissioning records.
evidence.claim: Apply a bounded cooling commissioning and initial derating distribution.

evidence.title: Synthetic uncertainty assumption — network readiness
evidence.excerpt: Network readiness distribution is hypothetical pending carrier contracts and route diversity documentation.
evidence.claim: Apply a modest network readiness delay distribution.
